task.pr_title: drawNoise/drawNoiseLayers as an effect so that json can use them

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: This is run at constructor time, which means that reassigning noisePath doesn't do anything. This may also cause issues on servers. How about `if(tex == null) tex = Core.assets.getOrNull(noisePath, Texture.class);` in render() instead?
